title: The Pieces Start Working Together
thesis: September showed growing evidence that AeroVista's shared capabilities can support multiple products, people, brands, and client outcomes while source, deployment, runtime acceptance, human acceptance, and professional authority remain separate proof gates.

sourceNote: This edition is a nontechnical shareholder presentation over the September 2026 evidence set. Current operating truth remains with each owning component and later dated handoffs; October completions are not back-credited into September.
